tooltip_definitions.Product Revenue: Consumables reagent kits, flow cells, and sequencing instruments (NovaSeq X, NextSeq, MiSeq).
tooltip_definitions.Service & Other Revenue: Maintenance service contracts, genomic sequencing lab services, and bioinformatic software licenses.
tooltip_definitions.NovaSeq X: Illumina's flagship ultra-high-throughput sequencing system reducing the cost of human genome sequencing.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Operating Margin: GAAP operating income adjusted for amortization of acquired intangibles, restructuring costs, and GRAIL divestiture charges.
tooltip_definitions.Clinical Sequencing Demand: Genomic testing in oncology, rare genetic diseases, and non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT).
tooltip_definitions.Research & Academic Demand: Sequencing volume from university research centers and government genomic initiatives.
tooltip_definitions.True FCF: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, stock-based compensation, and finance lease payments.
tooltip_definitions.Cost of Product Revenue: Raw materials, clean-room manufacturing, silicon wafer fabrication, and direct factory overhead.
tooltip_definitions.Gross Profit: Total revenue minus cost of product and service revenues ($1,129M - $299M = $830M, 73.52% margin).
tooltip_definitions.Research & Development: Investment in chemistry advances, 5-base sequencing, spatial biology, and long-read integration.
tooltip_definitions.Selling, General & Administrative: Global commercial sales teams, clinical field specialists, legal, and executive overhead.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Income (EBIT): Income from operations ($305M in Q3 2026, 27.02% GAAP operating margin).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net profit divided by diluted common shares ($1.43 across 154M diluted shares).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted earnings per share ($1.62 vs $1.36 consensus hurdle, beating by +$0.26).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated by sequencing consumables delivery and clinical customer collections ($419M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Purchases of property, plant, equipment, and lab tooling ($41M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.China Unreliable Entities List: Regulatory review and trade tensions regarding Illumina's genomic instrument imports into Greater China.
tooltip_definitions.IEEPA Tariff Refunds: International Emergency Economic Powers Act tariff recoveries recognized in Q3 cost of revenue.
tooltip_definitions.GRAIL Divestiture: Completed spin-off of cancer blood-biopsy unit GRAIL, restoring core genomics focus and margin profile.
tooltip_definitions.Cash Fortress: Available cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaling $1.34 billion.
